keywords: how do onitsuka tiger shoes fit
answer: Onitsuka Tiger sizes shoes by foot length in unisex US sizes, and puts a Size and Fit note on each product page. Those notes differ: the same MEXICO 66 colorway says to buy your normal size on the Danish site and a size smaller on the UK site. Measure your foot, then follow the note on the listing you order from.

sizeChart.caption: Onitsuka Tiger men's and unisex shoe size chart (US 5 to 12)
sizeChart.note: H marks a half size. Onitsuka Tiger says US sizes listed are unisex sizing, and women choosing unisex models should use the women's row of the chart.

sections.heading: Sizes are unisex
sections.body: Onitsuka Tiger's size guide says the US sizes it lists are unisex sizing. For women choosing unisex models, the guide says to refer to the women's row for a better size match and select the corresponding US size. Whether a shoe is unisex or women's is shown in the size selection on each product page.

sections.heading: Measure, then pick snug or loose
sections.body: The guide says to wear the socks you normally wear, stand with your heel against a wall, and measure from the base of the heel to the tip of your longest toe. Measure both feet and use the longer one. Onitsuka Tiger's own rule for preference is simple: for a tight fit, go one size down, and for a loose fit, go one size up.

sections.heading: Read the Size and Fit note on each listing
sections.body: Onitsuka Tiger product pages carry a Size and Fit line. For the MEXICO 66, most of the brand's European listings say to purchase your normal size, while the UK listing for the same style code says to purchase a size smaller. Because the advice can change by listing, read the note on the page you are actually buying from.

comparison: Like ASICS, Onitsuka Tiger writes half sizes as H on its chart. On Onitsuka Tiger's chart, a US 9 is 27 cm, the same as a US men's 9 on Nike's CM column.

faqs.q: Do Onitsuka Tigers fit true to size?
faqs.a: It depends on the listing. Onitsuka Tiger's product pages give their own Size and Fit note, and the MEXICO 66 says normal size on most European sites but a size smaller on the UK site. Check the note on the page you order from.

faqs.q: Are Onitsuka Tiger sizes men's or women's?
faqs.a: Onitsuka Tiger says the US sizes it lists are unisex. Women buying unisex models should use the women's row of the size chart to find the matching US size.

faqs.q: Should I size down in Onitsuka Tiger?
faqs.a: Onitsuka Tiger's guide says to go one size down for a tight fit and one size up for a loose fit. Some listings, such as the UK MEXICO 66 page, also recommend a size smaller.

faqs.q: How do I measure my foot for Onitsuka Tiger?
faqs.a: Wear your usual socks, stand with your heel against a wall, and measure from the heel to the tip of your longest toe. Measure both feet and use the longer one against the CM column.
